about: DRAFT relevance labels, written by Claude (an AI assistant) on 2026-11-04 by reading each of the 100 judgments' headnotes (the summary on page 1), not the search results. They have NOT been reviewed by a lawyer. Grades: 2 = on the topic of the query, 1 = partly relevant or a closely related issue; cases not listed are treated as not relevant. A legal reviewer should check and correct these before the results are relied on. Q01-Q22 are topic searches; Q23-Q28 (specific names, provisions and statutes) were added after the first run, because the first set had no searches of that kind.
dataset: Indian Supreme Court Judgments, 100-case subset (2022-2023), see docs/DATASET.md
